source: Seven MOVE forms/VIA with NOWAIT and supplied finite delay or complete node_times; no local clauses or selectors
admission: Exact detached operands/settings, idle ownership, response validation and stable root clock before pending publication; one job per group
progress: Root clock microseconds at checkpoints, successful standalone DELAY and scheduler boundaries; fractional remainder retained and elapsed milliseconds capped
controls: Independent groups; hold and pending/active pause freeze/reanchor, cancellation immediate, completion boundary first, stopped/foreign grant protections retained
scheduler: Owner-wait observation, scheduler-clock virtual deadlines only, owner cleanup/errors on poll failure and stable identities across task rename
lifetime: Linked launches belong to caller root after callee return; task terminal completion/stop/abort/failure cancel unfinished jobs at last observed progress
persistence: Terminal nowait/execution history only; active saves, pending reload and local handler/condition NOWAIT histories reject; no clocks/scopes/frames persisted
boundary: No trajectory, robot feedback, physical arrivals, native queue/group synchronization, callback handlers, compiler/controller or strict equivalence
